description: The generic Fallback Record emitted by narlib/chains.py for every chained capability: an ordered chain of rungs, one classified attempt per rung tried, the rung that served, and the fidelity the answer may honestly claim (ladder: source-equivalent > source-approximate > bytecode-listing > structural-summary > identified-only; a lower-fidelity result is never presented as higher). Every failed or partial attempt carries a classification that is exactly one FailureKind name from narlib/failures.py and a reason prefixed with that name; free-form failure strings are not permitted. The java-decompile chain's record is written as the case companion decompile.json and validated by decompile.schema.json, which embeds this same record shape for that capability.
title: NAR fallback chain record (Part 10.5)
